items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 5 at 4:48AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
Areas of fog, some locally dense, have developed early this
morning, resulting in roadway visibility of less than one mile.
Morning commuters should expect to encounter areas of rapidly
changing visibility.

If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you. If walking or cycling, wear bright or
reflective clothing and carry a light to increase your visibility
to drivers.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 5 at 12:55AM PDT until October 5 at 12:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to 1 NM or less.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM, Waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon OR
from 10 to 60 NM and Waters from Cape Falcon to Cape
Foulweather OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until noon PDT today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.
items.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.
